exposure: Type of surgery (e.g., caesarean section, explorative laparotomy)
cohort: 2,701 patients undergoing surgery at two hospitals in eastern Uganda
finding: The study found a low rate of surgery in the study setting compared to high-income settings, with high POMR observed following exploratory laparotomy and caesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found a high POMR (0.8%) for caesarean sections, with 59 (12%) of the 510 babies delivered through caesarean section being stillborn or dying before discharge.
